verdict.rationale: Airweave supports syncing/searching across many sources/collections at once, and Pipedream integration can 'trigger syncs' from workflows, suggesting some batch/automation capability, but there is no documented API or UI for bulk operations on many items (e.g., bulk delete, bulk re-tag, batch update across items) as a first-class feature. missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation endpoints/UI for acting on many items simultaneously, documentation or examples of batch item manipulation, independent confirmation of bulk workflows beyond sync triggers.
